canonical_source.behavior: Creates or edits the site profile, validates name and HTTP/HTTPS URL, persists the profile, then reloads authoritative Sites state.

laravel_adaptation.tenant_isolation: server-derived tenant.context; exact tenant slug match; tenant-scoped site lookup; foreign site 404
laravel_adaptation.caller_override_policy: Only name and url are accepted by update; tenant_id/status are rejected. Site tenant_id is server-derived by the tenant model scope.
laravel_adaptation.authoritative_reconciliation: React rereads the tenant Sites collection and confirms exact persisted name/url before reporting success.

terminality.basis: The canonical Sites SaveAsync is wired to real tenant-scoped Laravel persistence for create/edit, fails closed on authorization and cross-tenant identifiers, and reports success only after authoritative reread.
